items.source: A Task for bundling an application into an OCI image using a buildpack.
items.translation: 用于使用 构建包 将应用程序打包为 OCI 镜像的 Task。

items.source: Custom JavaExec task for running a Spring Boot application.
items.translation: 用于运行 Spring Boot 应用程序的自定义 JavaExec 任务。

items.source: An LayeredSpec.IntoLayersSpec that controls the layers to which application classes and resources belong.
items.translation: 一个LayeredSpec.IntoLayersSpec，用于控制应用程序类和资源所属的层。

items.source: An LayeredSpec.IntoLayersSpec that controls the layers to which dependencies belong.
items.translation: 一个LayeredSpec.IntoLayersSpec，用于控制依赖所属的层。

items.source: Task for resolving the name of the application's main class.
items.translation: Task 用于解析应用程序主类的名称。

items.source: Gradle plugin for Spring Boot AOT.
items.translation: Spring Boot AOT 的 Gradle 插件。

items.source: Entry point to Spring Boot's Gradle DSL.
items.translation: Spring Boot Gradle DSL 的入口点。

items.source: Gradle plugin for Spring Boot.
items.translation: Spring Boot Gradle 插件。

items.source: Extracts version information for a Class.
items.translation: 提取类的版本信息。

items.source: Task for generating a build-info.properties file from a Project.
items.translation: Task 用于从 Project 生成 build-info.properties 文件。

items.source: Specialization of JavaExec to be used as a base class for tasks that perform ahead-of-time processing.
items.translation: `JavaExec` 类的特化版本，用作执行提前处理任务的基类。

items.source: A custom Jar task that produces a Spring Boot executable jar.

items.translation: 自定义 JavaExec 任务，用于提前处理 Spring Boot 应用程序。

items.source: Custom JavaExec task for ahead-of-time processing of a Spring Boot application's tests.
items.translation: 自定义 JavaExec 任务，用于提前处理 Spring Boot 应用程序的测试。

items.source: The properties that are written into the build-info.properties file.
items.translation: 写入到 build-info.properties 文件的属性。

items.source: A Spring Boot "fat" archive task.
items.translation: 一个 Spring Boot“胖”归档任务。

items.source: Configuration for an image building cache.
items.translation: 用于镜像构建缓存的配置。

items.source: Configuration for an image building cache stored in a bind mount.
items.translation: 用于存储在绑定挂载中的镜像构建缓存的配置。

items.source: Configuration for an image building cache stored in a Docker volume.
items.translation: 用于存储在 Docker 卷中的镜像构建缓存的配置。

items.translation: 封装分层归档的配置。

items.source: Spec that controls the dependencies that should be part of a particular layer.
items.translation: 控制应包含在特定层中的依赖项的规范。

items.source: Spec that controls the content that should be part of a particular layer.
items.translation: 控制特定层应包含内容的规范。

items.source:
Base class for specs that control the layers to which a category of content should
belong.
items.translation: 控制内容类别应归属的层的规范基类。

items.source: An enumeration of supported compression options for an entry in a ZIP archive.
items.translation: ZIP 归档中条目支持的压缩选项枚举。
